newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian police find child's corpse.
newsitem.headline: Belgian police find child's corpse.

text.p: Belgian police found the body of an child in a derelict building in Brussels on Wednesday evening, RTBF radio said on Wednesday.
Police spokeswoman Els Cleemput told the station: "They have found the body of a child." An autopsy was to be carried out on Wednesday night.
Belga news agency quoted Cleemput as saying the body, found in the trunk of a car parked in the cellar of a petrol station in the Ixelles commune of Brussels, had not yet been identified.
Further details would not be released until the results of the autopsy were known, it said.
BRTN radio said police would hold a news conference, possibly later on Wednesday night.

BRTN said police investigators had on Wednesday been searching that section of Ixelles where five years ago Moroccan-born Loubna Benaissa vanished. It was not immediately clear that the searches had concerned her disappearance.
